subject: 镇国寺万佛殿 · 正面
author: Zeus1234
source_note: Zeus1234于2009年实拍万佛殿，按三间四柱、深檐大斗拱绘制，省去两侧附属建筑。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. One fine contour heritage drawing for 访古. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY, its delicate sparse black contours and empty white planes. Image 2 is GEOMETRY: actual Wanfo Hall of Zhenguo Temple, Pingyao, Northern Han 963. Draw the single hall from the front, preserve THREE front bays / FOUR front columns, small low facade under an oversized deep single-eave hip-and-gable roof, very prominent large simple bracket arms and high curved ridge-end ornaments. Central rectangular doorway, largely plain solid side wall bays; do not invent a full bank of lattice doors. Keep the broad low platform. Entire roof and base centered with 12% side margins on landscape 1536x1024. Remove attached neighboring side halls, courtyard pots, incense burner, benches, trees, tourists, all signs and plaque lettering. PURE WHITE planes bounded by fine slightly organic black contours, NOT detailed blueprint. Roof must remain WHITE with just THREE or FOUR faint short tile-suggestion strokes, NOT rows of tiles. Reduce brackets to selective main arm outlines with much space between lines. No solid doorway fill, no shading, no dense ornament, no hatching, no text, no framing border. Match the master line weight and restrained white-space composition.

site_recommendation.name: 平遥镇国寺
site_recommendation.yearNote: 北汉天会七年纪年；963年虽已进入北宋纪年，山西此地仍属北汉，不改归宋构。
site_recommendation.lede: 万佛殿的屋顶显得格外宽大，巨大的斗拱将深檐托出。小小三间殿堂，留住了北汉时期木构的尺度与气息。
facts: 万佛殿建于北汉天会七年（963），属于五代十国时期的现存木构。
面阔三间，单檐歇山顶；硕大的铺作与深远出檐形成鲜明比例。
镇国寺与平遥古城、双林寺共同构成世界遗产；图版选万佛殿一座。
